assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容组织、讨论与返修，官方几何发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry is provisional.

assumptions.statement_zh: 物流设施涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; concept-level only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 配送量与车辆规模数据仅有公开口径，本方案不引用未核实数值，不编造车辆数量、配送量或站点数据。
assumptions.statement_en: No unverified delivery-volume or fleet figures are cited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 配送调度与安全监测均以匿名聚合为边界，不进行个体识别式追踪、不建立大规模行为画像，关键决策人工复核。
assumptions.statement_en: Anonymized aggregation only; no individual-identifying tracking; human review for key decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 低速无人配送路权与设施设置涉及交通与市容管理政策，本方案仅作概念建议，不构成路权或运营承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Delivery route rights and facility siting are concept-level suggestions; no commitment implied.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI生成的服务信息须经人工审核后发布，遵守版权与署名要求，不夸大配送能力、不把设想写成已确定安排。
assumptions.statement_en: AI-generated service information requires human review; no overstated claims.
